title: noah-wilson-daily-notes-2026-03-04
content:
Daily scratchpad - Noah W. (quick, messy)
Date: 2026-03-04 (migrated to shared drive 2026-03-05)

Morning priorities:
- Finish perf regression triage for RD-3421 (KV cache edge-case). Reproduced reliably with seq_len=1024 workload on staging; root cause looks like delayed KV release on fallback path. I opened branch fix/kv-release-3421 and a draft PR (see linked_artifacts). Next: run the full seq_len=2048 run overnight to verify scale.
- Merge small hotfix for batching timeout (PR #987) — merged 2026-03-04 after rerunning the flaky cpu-mem step in CircleCI. Monitor canaries for the next 24h.
- Prep notes for 11:00 sync with SRE about autoscale cooldown tuning (bring updated 95th latency numbers and baseline from the pre-merge snapshot).

Quick TODOs (short):
- Ping Maya about canary rollout thresholds (Slack: @maya). Update: Maya confirmed 3% initial canary, ramp to 20% if no regressions at 30m.
- Add two prompts to eval set: `prompt-kv-edge-1` and `prompt-kv-edge-2` - record expected outputs and add to automated eval job.
- Remove old experiment cluster (exp-2024-q4) from inventory - infra asked for a deprovision window; follow-up to schedule during next maintenance window.

Meeting notes / follow-ups:
- 10:00 standup: remind team about de-prioritizing new quantization proposal until after dedicated benchmark. Action: move quantization backlog item to next sprint.
- 11:00 SRE sync: after discussion, agreed on target_spare_capacity=0.10 and cooldown=180s for dedicated pools (reduced spare to save cost). SRE to run a 4-hour soak on staging + a 2-hour prod canary at 5% traffic. Action: SRE (Liam) to post soak results by EOD 2026-03-06.
- 14:00 Design review w/ Console team: showed cost-breakdown mockups, asked for per-route grouping option and tags for cost owners. Action: share Figma link and short one-pager; follow up about adding a toggle for per-route vs per-service rollups.

Bugs / unknowns to investigate:
- Memory spike after ~250k tokens on long-session test (session-id: sess-7f3a). Current hypothesis confirmed: delayed KV.release on fallback path. Staging test with the fix shows ~40% reduction in peak memory; still running extended soak to validate.
- Intermittent 503s when routing to variant-small during burst; after adjusting backpressure config in canary, error rate dropped but need 24h monitoring to be confident.

Actionables for engineering:
- Run overnight seq_len=2048 job on staging (low concurrency) to validate fix/kv-release-3421.
- Add rollback criteria to rollout doc: latency regression threshold = +10% P95 or error rate >0.5% sustained for 15m.
- Snapshot current perf dashboards before any further experiments (Console > Dashboards > Serving > Last 7d) — saved snapshot id noted in Confluence draft.

Personal / errands (non-work):
- Dentist appointment rescheduled to 2026-03-10 at 16:30 - calendar updated.
- Pick up prescription after standup (pharmacy closes 18:00) — done.
- Grocery: milk, eggs, spinach, coffee pods.

Notes to self (random):
- If repro script fails locally, try reproducing on staging with reduced concurrency first — less noisy and more likely to match infra behavior.
- When writing rollout doc, include rollback criteria + latency regression threshold (+10% P95) and the canary traffic schedule.
- Save a snapshot of current perf dashboards before running experiments and attach to the PR/rollout doc.

Quick links I might need:
- KV cache idea page: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/123456789/kv-cache-ideas
- RD-3421 ticket
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/987
- Fix branch PR (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1002

End of scratchpad. Will polish into a proper doc if any of the follow-ups require a public writeup.
